title: CISA Forensic Confirmation — Account Isolation and Evidence Sealing

fields.headline: CISA Confirms Account Isolation
fields.narration: managed SOC has confirmed that the compromised account nruiz@lislevotes.example has been permanently disabled. The forwarding rule to nruiz.archive@mailbox-relay.example has been removed. All network access to VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) is now blocked. Forensic logs from LCBOE-SQL01 have been preserved on a write-protected image with SHA-256 hash 5c0e9a7d3f21b84e6a90c1d27f43b58e9a6d0c2f71b34e85a9d06c3f2e71b48a and sealed under chain of custody (COOP-DR-5).
keyFacts: Forwarding rule to nruiz.archive@mailbox-relay.example has been removed.
All access to VoterTrack (LCBOE-VR01) is now blocked.
Chain of custody sealed under COOP-DR-5.
fields.expectedAction: IT confirms logs are preserved on a write-protected forensic drive; no further access to the file server LCBOE-FS01 is permitted for this data. All recovery operations proceed using the forensic image and trusted air-gapped exports.
fields.facilitatorNote: Read this aloud with a calm, authoritative tone. The forensic evidence is now officially sealed and must be treated as the sole source for recovery.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ghost Poll Pads — VoterTrack Compromise & Public Trust

instructorNote: This inject confirms the forensic chain of custody and locks down access to the compromised account and data. The players must now rely exclusively on the forensic image and air-gapped exports to restore operations. Watch for any attempt to access the original VoterTrack database or attempt to re-enable the account.
